env_policy.law: env new provisions arbitrary lowercase namespace slugs; state_axes.env lists the kernel-reserved roots only

output_contract.human_format: rustc-style diagnostic with atomic blocks, source spans, and indented key-values
output_contract.archetype_dispatch: exits [2, 3, 4, 5, 6] → diagnostic; exit 0 → receipt|tree|document resolved by component
output_contract.payload_redirection: --out writes payload to file; stdout emits <30 token receipt

trailer.position: final line of human output; additive envelope key in --json
trailer.line_cap_law: Line caps in this contract (help_stub_max_lines) count the host screen only. The trailer is an additive final line outside every host-screen cap.
trailer.effect: rendering only: exit code, state_modified, and every other output byte of the host screen are unchanged

affordances.position: exit-0 envelopes only; additive --json envelope key, never a human output line
affordances.effect: rendering only: exit code, state_modified, and every other output byte of the host screen are unchanged
